  f = fopen("/app/bits.txt", "w");

payload.purpose: Construct and validate a code using exact emitted-prefix constraints for the supplied decoder.
payload.script:
set -e
cd /app
# The range path depends only on desired bits. At each normalization, P is the
# emitted base-255 prefix and decoder fraction is P-offset. Constrain the full
# 2500-digit code according to the exact integer split used by decomp.c.
awk '
BEGIN { rr=1; k=0 }
{
  bit=$1; ctx=$2; ix=2*ctx
  if (rr < 255) {
    print "rr=rr*255; off=off*255; unit=unit/255"
    rr*=255; k++
  }
  print "sp=rr*(c[" ix "]+1)/(c[" ix "]+c[" ix+1"]+2); bd=(off+sp)*unit"
  if (bit==0) print "if(hi>bd) hi=bd"
  else print "if(lo<bd) lo=bd; off=off+sp"
  print "c[" ix+bit"]++"
  if (bit==0) rr=int(rr*(0+1)/(0+0+2)) # placeholder replaced below
}
' bits.txt > /app/raw_constraints.txt
# Replace the placeholder range evolution with an awk pass that has both counts
# and exact integer split, emitting only the corresponding bc statements.
awk '
BEGIN { rr=1 }
{
  bit=$1; ctx=$2; ix=2*ctx
  if (rr < 255) { print "rr=rr*255; off=off*255; unit=unit/255"; rr*=255 }
  den=c[ix]+c[ix+1]+2; sp=int(rr*(c[ix]+1)/den)
  print "sp=rr*(c[" ix "]+1)/(c[" ix "]+c[" ix+1"]+2); bd=(off+sp)*unit"
  if(bit==0) print "if(hi>bd) hi=bd"
  else print "if(lo<bd) lo=bd; off=off+sp"
  print "c[" ix+bit"]++"
  if(bit) rr-=sp; else rr=sp
}
' bits.txt > /app/constraints.bc
{
  echo 'scale=0'
  echo 'if(1) {'
  echo 'base=1; for(i=0;i<2500;i++) base=base*255'
  echo 'lo=0; hi=base; unit=base; off=0; rr=1'
  cat /app/constraints.bc
  echo 'if(lo>=hi) quit'
  echo 'x=lo; for(i=0;i<2500;i++){ dig[i]=x%255; x=x/255 }'
  echo 'for(i=2499;i>=0;i--) print dig[i]'
  echo '}'
} > /app/encode.bc
bc /app/encode.bc > /app/digits.txt
[ "$(wc -l < /app/digits.txt)" -eq 2500 ]
awk 'NR==1{mn=$1;mx=$1} {if($1<mn)mn=$1;if($1>mx)mx=$1} END{exit !(NR==2500 && mn>=0 && mx<=254)}' /app/digits.txt
awk '{printf "%c", $1+1}' /app/digits.txt > /app/data.comp
[ "$(wc -c < /app/data.comp)" -eq 2500 ]
/app/decomp < /app/data.comp > /app/decoded.txt
cmp -s /app/decoded.txt /app/data.txt
wc -c /app/data.comp /app/decoded.txt

payload.purpose: Generate data.comp with exact arbitrary-precision interval arithmetic matching the decompressor, then perform an end-to-end byte comparison.
payload.script:
set -e
cd /app
cat > /tmp/mkinterval.rb <<'RUBY'
base = 255 ** 2500
lo = 0; hi = base; unit = base; off = 0; rr = 1
counts = Hash.new(0); n = 0
File.foreach('bits.records') do |line|
  m = /\A([01]) ([0-9]+)\n?\z/.match(line) or raise "bad record #{n + 1}"
  bit = m[1].to_i; ix = 2 * m[2].to_i
  if rr < 255
    rr *= 255; off *= 255; unit /= 255
  end
  split = rr * (counts[ix] + 1) / (counts[ix] + counts[ix + 1] + 2)
  boundary = (off + split) * unit
  if bit == 1
    lo = boundary if lo < boundary
    off += split; rr -= split
  else
    hi = boundary if hi > boundary
    rr = split
  end
  counts[ix + bit] += 1
  n += 1
  raise "empty interval at #{n}" unless lo < hi
end
raise "too few records" unless n > 1000
x = lo; digits = Array.new(2500)
2499.downto(0) { |i| digits[i] = x % 255; x /= 255 }
raise 'code overflow' unless x == 0
File.binwrite('data.comp', digits.map { |d| d + 1 }.pack('C*'))
warn "records=#{n} interval_nonempty=1 bytes=#{digits.length}\n"
RUBY
ruby /tmp/mkinterval.rb
[ "$(wc -c < data.comp)" -eq 2500 ]
/app/decomp < data.comp > decoded.txt
cmp -s decoded.txt data.txt
printf 'compressed=%s decoded=%s exact=1\n' "$(wc -c < data.comp)" "$(wc -c < decoded.txt)"
